1. (Currently amended) A method for content optimization, comprising: receiving a rule on probability factor, the rule on probability factor specifying a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a particular value of a selected content attribute; generating a plurality of pieces of content in accordance with the rule on probability factor __using machine learning algorithms to automatically vary content parameters__; collecting content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content when the plurality of pieces of content are in use __through real-time user interaction tracking__; determining, by a processor, an aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute having the particular value based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content __by calculating statistical correlations between content attributes and user engagement metrics__; and modifying, by the processor, the rule on probability factor based on the aggregated performance data __by dynamically adjusting probability distributions to optimize future content generation__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a size or position adjustment, or an attribute of a transition, __and wherein the content optimization is performed for digital advertising campaigns with measurable conversion rates__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: determining, by the processor, a deviation value for aggregated performance data the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content __by computing variance metrics across multiple content variations__, wherein the modifying step comprises modifying the rule on probability factor based on both the aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute __using adaptive learning algorithms that account for statistical significance__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: receiving a set of rules for content generation __defining content generation parameters for automated marketing campaigns__; identifying a changeable content attribute based on the set of rules for content generation __through automated analysis of content performance patterns__; and composing, by the processor, one or more rules on probability factor for the changeable content attribute __using predictive modeling to establish initial probability distributions__.

8. (Currently amended) A content optimization system, comprising: a rule management module maintaining a set of rules for content generation, the set of rules comprising a rule on probability factor, the rule on probability factor specifying a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a particular value of a selected content attribute __for automated digital content campaigns__; a content generation module operative to generate a plurality of pieces of content based on the set of rules, the plurality of pieces of content designed with a particular optimization objective __using machine learning algorithms to create content variations__; and a content evaluation module operative to evaluate content performance on reaching the particular optimization objective based on data acquired when the plurality of pieces of content are displayed __through real-time analytics and user interaction monitoring__, wherein the content evaluation module is further operative to determine an aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute having the particular value based on the evaluated content performance __by calculating statistical correlations between attributes and performance metrics__, wherein the rule management module is operative to amend the rule on probability factor based on the aggregated content performance data __using adaptive algorithms that dynamically optimize probability distributions__.

9. (Currently amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a metric adjustment, or an attribute of a transition, __and wherein the system operates on digital advertising content with trackable user engagement metrics__.

10. (Currently amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the content evaluation module is further operative to determine a deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content __by computing statistical variance across content variations__, and wherein the rule management module is further operative to modify the rule on probability factor based on both the aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute __using machine learning algorithms that account for statistical significance in optimization decisions__.

11. (Currently amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the rule management module is further operative to identify a changeable content attribute based on the set of rules for content generation __through automated pattern recognition of performance data__ and compose a rule on probability factor for the changeable content attribute __using predictive modeling algorithms__.

13. (Currently amended) A method comprising: receiving a first rule on probability factor and a second rule on probability factor, the first rule on probability factor defining a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a first value of a selected content attribute, the second rule on probability factor defining a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a second value of the selected content attribute, the second value being different from the first value __wherein the rules are generated using machine learning algorithms for content optimization__; generating a plurality of pieces of content in accordance with the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor __using automated content generation systems__; collecting content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content when the plurality of pieces of content are in use __through real-time user interaction tracking and analytics__; determining, by a processor, a first aggregated performance data for the first value of the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content __by calculating statistical correlations between the first value and user engagement metrics__; determining, by a processor, a second aggregated performance data for the second value of the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content __by calculating statistical correlations between the second value and user engagement metrics__; and modifying, by the processor, the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor based on both the first aggregated performance data and the second aggregated performance data __using adaptive learning algorithms that dynamically optimize probability distributions__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a metric adjustment, or an attribute of a transition, __and wherein the method is applied to digital advertising content with measurable conversion rates__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising: determining, by the processor, a deviation value for the first aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content __by computing statistical variance metrics__, wherein the modifying step comprises modifying the first rule on probability factor based on both the first aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the first aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute __using machine learning algorithms that account for statistical significance in optimization__.
